# measurement determinacy

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:measurementDeterminacy`](gmeow-measurementDeterminacy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/measurementDeterminacy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The ontic determinacy model of a temporal measurement — crisp, vague, fuzzy, probabilistic, or disputed. Bridges to [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md) ([rdfs:subPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf)) so generic consumers can query determinacy uniformly across all domains.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md) -> [`gmeow:Determinacy`](../classes/gmeow-Determinacy.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:measurementDeterminacy`](gmeow-measurementDeterminacy.md) from [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md) to [`gmeow:Determinacy`](../classes/gmeow-Determinacy.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md), [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md), [`gmeow:Determinacy`](../classes/gmeow-Determinacy.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare the ontic determinacy model of a dating result — a radiocarbon date is probabilistic, a stratigraphic boundary often vague — queryable through the [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md) bridge.

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating it with the numeric error bar ([`gmeow:measurementUncertainty`](gmeow-measurementUncertainty.md)) or with epistemic confidence; determinacy is the nature of the value, an axis orthogonal to how large the uncertainty is (P9).

### How to use

- Reference one [`gmeow:Determinacy`](../classes/gmeow-Determinacy.md) individual; the [rdfs:subPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf) [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md) bridge exposes it to generic determinacy queries, while the solver layer does the fuzzy/probabilistic math (P12).

### Examples

- ex:charcoalDate [`gmeow:measurementDeterminacy`](gmeow-measurementDeterminacy.md) [`gmeow:determinacyProbabilistic`](../individuals/gmeow-determinacyProbabilistic.md).
